The Charm vanishes from you after you use it, if you use this feature again, or if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 10. Once you receive a Charm in this way, you can't gain another until your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe increases.

entries.name: Revered
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Darkspear Tribe}

When you request a Charm from the loa, you can choose from the following additional Potion effects for your Charm: {@item Potion of Clairvoyance|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Diminution|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Gaseous Form|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Fire Giant Strength|XDMG|Potion of Giant Strength} (fire), {@item Potion of Superior Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing} (superior), {@item Potion of Mana (Superior)|WoW|Potion of Mana} (superior), {@item Potion of Heroism|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Invisibility|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Invulnerability|XDMG}, or {@item Potion of Mind Reading|XDMG}.
If you choose one of the options listed above, the Charm vanishes from you if your Renown Score with the Darkspear tribe falls below 25.

reward.name: Dimir Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell blink} or {@spell sleep} (3rd-level version) spell. Alternatively, when you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn {@condition invisible} and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Draconic Familiar
entries: You gain the aid of a draconic familiar, which might be a splinter of the consciousness of a dragon that invested you with power.

You can cast the {@spell find familiar} spell as a ritual without using any material components. When you cast the spell in this way, your familiar always takes the form of a {@creature pseudodragon}.
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your pseudodragon familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction.

reward.name: Draconic Rebirth
entries: You become a dragonborn. You replace the racial traits of your original race with the traits of a chromatic, gem, or metallic dragonborn (detailed in this {@book book|FTD|1|Draconic Races}). The kind of dragonborn you become matches the family of the dragon that is the source of this gift. You can keep any skill proficiencies you gained from your previous race, or you gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

reward.name: Draconic Senses
entries: You gain keen senses like a dragon's.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: You have {@sense blindsight} to a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind {@quickref cover||3||total cover}, even if you're {@condition blinded} or in darkness. Moreover, you can see {@condition invisible} creatures within that range, unless the creatures successfully hide from you.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

reward.name: Dragon Queen's Will
entries: You've seen a glimpse of the Dragon Queen's ambitions. It haunts your dreams but steels your will to oppose her. This charm grants you a +4 bonus on Wisdom saving throws. Once used three times, the charm vanishes. While you have this charm, you suffer unsettling but harmless dreams of ravenous dragons. You also permanently gain the ability to speak Draconic if you couldn't already.

reward.name: Echo of Dragonsight
entries: You have begun to extend your awareness beyond the single world of the Material Plane that is your home.

You can cast {@spell contact other plane} as a ritual. The entity you contact is a dragon on another world in the Material Plane, so its knowledge of your world might be limited. Also, this dragon is an echo of the dragon who is the source of the gift, which might affect its attitude and behavior toward you.

reward.name: Ephara's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Ephara trait}

Ephara grants you insight into how people communicate. You can cast {@spell comprehend languages} with this trait, requiring no material component, a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Ephara's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Ephara trait}

You can cast {@spell Mordenkainen's private sanctum} with this trait, requiring no material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Ephara's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Ephara trait}
You gain advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks while you are within a city.

In addition, when you fail an Intelligence check or Intelligence saving throw, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll. Once you use this reroll, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Erebos's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Erebos trait}

As a devotee of Erebos, you have proven yourself an executor of the Underworld's grim laws. You can call on Erebos's favor to cast {@spell bane} with this trait, requiring no material components, a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Erebos's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Erebos trait}

When a soul is sent to its rightful place, you can draw on the energy of the Underworld to empower you. When a creature dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your level.

reward.name: Erebos's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Erebos trait}
You can cast {@spell vampiric touch} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Eyes of the Impossible
entries: You are scarred by knowledge you shouldn't possess. Your eyes turn black, except for your pupils, which turn white. This charm grants you advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made to interact with evil creatures. Additionally, you can cast the spell {@spell eyebite} as an action. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice when you gain this charm). Once you cast this spell, you can't cast it again until the next dawn. This charm vanishes after 13 days, when your appearance returns to normal.

reward.name: Favor of the Heroic Steed
entries: Two heroic steeds find you worthy and agree to serve you. This charm has 2 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to summon a {@creature warhorse} wearing plate barding (AC 18). The warhorse serves you for 24 hours, then vanishes.

reward.name: Final Breath
entries: A deity's favored servant lies dying and calls down divine wrath.

entries.name: Pronouncement
entries: The dying creature declares to the killer, "May your mind grow dim in battle until the sun sets forever."

entries.name: Burden
entries: The character has disadvantage on attack rolls brought on by brief, sporadic bouts of confusion.

entries.name: Resolution
entries: To lift the curse, the character must cause a symbolic setting of the sun or an empowering of the night to appease the slain creature's deity. The character might prevent a festival dedicated to a sun god or perform a ritual that shrouds an entire settlement in magical night for 24 hours, thus ending the curse.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll, you can force the target to move up to 10 feet away from you in a direction of your choice. A creature that can't be {@condition frightened} is immune to this effect.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: If you start your turn {@condition frightened}, you take {@damage 2d6} psychic damage.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: You can't be {@condition frightened} while within 10 feet of an ally. If you're already {@condition frightened} and move within 10 feet of an ally, the {@condition frightened} condition ends on you.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You have disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws while you aren't within 10 feet of an ally.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn {@condition invisible} and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You remain {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn or until you make a damage roll or cast a spell.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You have disadvantage on Wisdom checks.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: You are immune to the {@condition charmed} condition.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You can't take the {@action Help} action.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: Another creature can't force you to move anywhere you don't want to go.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You can't take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dodge} action.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: When a creature damages you with a weapon attack or a spell, you can focus your hatred on that creature. Until the end of your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls you make against the creature. You can focus your hatred on only one creature at a time.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You have disadvantage on Charisma checks.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: When you fail a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, you can reroll it with advantage, potentially turning a failure into a success. After you use this benefit, you must finish a long rest before you can use it again.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: If you use this fragment's benefit and it doesn't turn a failed saving throw into a success, you are {@condition incapacitated} until the end of your next turn, overcome with despair.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: Each time you spend a Hit Die to regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: You have disadvantage on death saving throws.

entries.name: Benefit
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can choose to deal either an extra {@damage 2d6} psychic damage to the creature or {@damage 4d6} psychic damage to each other creature within 5 feet of it. After you use this benefit, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: Whenever you are not {@condition unconscious} and fail a saving throw, you take {@damage 2d6} psychic damage.

reward.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Echoes of a dragon's might linger around you, and you can call on them to inspire fear in those who stand against you.

As a bonus action, you can manifest your frightful presence. Each creature of your choice that is within 120 feet of you and aware of you must make a Wisdom saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. A creature that fails becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Golgari Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell false life} (3rd-level version), or {@spell stinking cloud} spell. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Gruul Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell heroism} or {@spell thunderwave} spell (3rd-level versions). Alternatively, as a reaction when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another attack against the target you missed. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Habbakuk's Blessing
entries: Habbakuk blesses your travels through the Northern Wastes. This charm grants you advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to notice the Wash's waters filling chasms.

Additionally, while traveling, you and up to 5 other creatures with you ignore {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain} outdoors in the Northern Wastes, allowing you to move at double the pace listed on the Northern Wastes Land Travel table (see the "{@adventure Into the Wastes|DSotDQ|5|Into the Wastes}" section earlier in this chapter).
This charm vanishes 24 hours after you leave the Northern Wastes.

reward.name: Heliod's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Heliod trait}

As a devotee of Heliod, you have proven yourself a worthy champion of the sun god. You can call on Heliod's favor and cast {@spell bless} with this trait, requiring no material components. Heliod's blessing manifests as a nimbus around the affected creatures, causing them to shed dim light in a 5-foot radius until the spell ends. You can cast the spell in this way a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Heliod's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Heliod trait}
You grow accustomed to the blazing radiance of the sun; you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition blinded}, and you have resistance to fire damage.

reward.name: Heliod's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Heliod trait}
You can cast {@spell daylight} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Hellscream's Warsong
entries: Whenever you roll damage, you can reroll any die that shows a 1 or 2 but must use the new roll. The Blessing lasts until Arthas is defeated.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Female

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: CN

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Fickle and unpredictable

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I never stick to a plan."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Obo'laka

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host's Dexterity score becomes 23, unless it is already higher.

reward.name: Innocent Blood
entries: The tragic situation came to pass where a character killed an undeserving person, who laid a vengeful curse in punishment.

entries.name: Pronouncement
entries: The dying victim spits final words: "You shall spill innocent blood until laid low by the moon's bite!"

entries.name: Burden
entries: The character is cursed with {@creature loup garou|VRGR} {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|lycanthropy} (see {@book chapter 5|VRGR|5}).

entries.name: Resolution
entries: This curse can't be broken until the character is reduced to 0 hit points by a silvered weapon. If the character survives, the curse can be broken as described in the "{@creature Loup Garou|VRGR|5|Loup Garou Lycanthropy}" section of {@book chapter 5|VRGR|5}. Treat the character as a {@creature werewolf} whose loup garou progenitor has been killed.

reward.name: Iroas's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Iroas trait}

As a devotee of Iroas, you have earned his favor through victories won in his name. You can cast {@spell compelled duel} with this trait a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Iroas's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Iroas trait}

As a bonus action, you can call on Iroas's blessing, gaining the following benefit for 1 minute or until you are {@condition incapacitated}: creatures within 30 feet of you can't gain advantage on attack rolls against you. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Iroas's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Iroas trait}
You can cast {@spell crusader's mantle} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

reward.name: Izzet Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell dispel magic} or {@spell lightning bolt} spell. Alternatively, as an action, you can regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Joho's Charm
entries: While you have Joho in your possession, it grants you the benefit of a {@item helm of comprehending languages}. This benefit lasts for 7 days while the doll is in your possession, after which the charm vanishes from you.
The doll is a Tiny construct. Destroying the doll causes the child's soul within it to become trapped in {@adventure the Soulmonger|ToA|5|The Soulmonger}.

reward.name: Karametra's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Karametra trait}

As a devotee of Karametra, you have proven yourself a worthy potential champion of the harvest god. As a bonus action, you can invoke her protection; spectral plants cover you, providing you with a +1 bonus to AC for 1 minute. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Karametra's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Karametra trait}

By performing an hour-long ritual, you can conjure enough grapes to fill three vials (4 ounces each) of wine. Each vial serves as a {@item potion of healing} for 24 hours, after which it loses this property. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Karametra's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Karametra trait}

You can cast {@spell create food and water} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

reward.name: Keranos's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Keranos trait}

As a devotee of Keranos, you have proven your wisdom and your allegiance to the storm lord. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage to the target. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Keranos's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Keranos trait}
The energy of the storm fills your being, granting you advantage on initiative rolls.

reward.name: Keranos's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Keranos trait}
When you fail an Intelligence or a Wisdom saving throw, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Klothys's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Klothys trait}

As a devotee of Klothys, you can manipulate the bonds of destiny that invisibly entangle every living thing. You can cast {@spell command} with this trait a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Klothys's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Klothys trait}
You develop a second sense, allowing you to intuit the tug and pull of destiny. You can't be surprised, provided you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

reward.name: Klothys's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Klothys trait}

You can cast {@spell clairvoyance} with this trait, requiring no material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}.

reward.name: Kruphix's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Kruphix trait}

As a devotee of Kruphix, you have proven yourself a devotee of reality's mysteries and laws. You can cast {@spell detect magic} with this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
In addition, you know the {@spell mage hand} cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

reward.name: Kruphix's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Kruphix trait}

As a true champion of Kruphix, you can use your {@spell mage hand} cantrip to protect yourself. While your spectral hand is within 5 feet of you, you gain a +2 bonus to your AC against ranged attacks.

reward.name: Kruphix's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Kruphix trait}

You can cast {@spell detect thoughts} with this trait, requiring no material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Male

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: CG

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Wild and spirited

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I am fearless and not afraid to take great risks."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Papazotl

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host's Strength score becomes 23, unless it is already higher.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Daanvi, the Perfect Order
entries: You can expend the Charm (no action required) to end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on yourself.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Dolurrh, the Realm of the Dead
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell from the Necromancy school, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Fernia, the Sea of Fire
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals Fire damage, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Irian, the Eternal Dawn
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell that restores Hit Points or deals Radiant damage, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Lamannia, the Twilight Forest
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell that conjures or summons a Beast, an Elemental, or a Fey (including {@spell Conjure Animals|XPHB}, {@spell Conjure Elemental|XPHB}, {@spell Conjure Fey|XPHB}, {@spell Conjure Minor Elementals|XPHB}, {@spell Conjure Woodland Beings|XPHB}, {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}, {@spell Summon Beast|XPHB}, {@spell Summon Elemental|XPHB}, or {@spell Summon Fey|XPHB}), you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Mabar, the Endless Night
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell that animates or summons an Undead (including {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB}, {@spell Create Undead|XPHB}, or {@spell Summon Undead|XPHB}), you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Risia, the Plain of Ice
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals Cold damage, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to treat the spell as if it were cast using a spell slot 1 level above the slot expended.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Shavarath, the Battleground
entries: When you score a Critical Hit, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to deal an extra 10 damage of one of the types dealt by the attack.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Syrania, the Azure Sky
entries: You can expend the Charm as a Bonus Action to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 minute.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Thelanis, the Faerie Court
entries: When you cast a spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to give one target of the spell Disadvantage on its saving throw against the spell.

reward.name: Manifest Charm of Xoriat, the Realm of Delirium
entries: When you use a spell slot to cast a spell, you can expend the Charm (no action required) to roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|XPHB|Wild Magic Surge table} in the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Male

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: LG

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Truthful and kind

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I must always speak the truth."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Wongo

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can use an action to turn {@condition invisible}. Anything the host is wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on the host's person. The effect ends if the host attacks, casts a spell, forces a saving throw, or deals damage.

reward.name: Mogis's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Mogis trait}

As a devotee of Mogis, you have shown yourself to be a brutal combatant. You can call on Mogis's favor and cast {@spell wrathful smite} with this trait. Mogis's blessing manifest as a blood-red glow around your weapon, causing it to shed dim light in a 5-foot radius until the spell ends. You can cast the spell in this way a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Mogis's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Mogis trait}
Countless battles and vicious visions have given you focus. You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

reward.name: Mogis's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Mogis trait}

You can cast {@spell blinding smite} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Female

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: NE

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Selfish and cruel

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I won't share with others."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Shagambi

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. It gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

reward.name: Nylea's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Nylea trait}

As a devotee of Nylea, you have proven yourself a guardian of the wilds. You can cast {@spell hunter's mark} with this trait a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Nylea's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Nylea trait}

When a beast is about to attack you, it must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses you. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this trait for 24 hours.

reward.name: Nylea's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Nylea trait}

You can cast {@spell speak with animals} with this trait a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Female

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: LN

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Nervous and obsessive

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I am risk-averse and a slave to routine."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: I'jin

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can attune to one additional magic item. When Obo'laka leaves the host, all magic items to which the host is attuned are no longer attuned to it.

reward.name: Observatory Charm
entries: You can use your Observatory to peer into the far corners of {@book Wildspace|XDMG|5|Wildspace} and the {@book Astral Plane|XDMG|5|Astral Plane}. After spending a Long Rest in your Observatory, you gain a magical Charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Contact Other Plane|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

reward.name: Orzhov Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell bestow curse} or {@spell fear} spell. Alternatively, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to have it drop to 1 hit point instead. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Male

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: LE

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Shrewd and conniving

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I bow before no one and expect others to do as I command."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Kubazan

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can't be {@status surprised}, gains advantage on all Wisdom checks, and never takes damage from falling.

reward.name: Pharika's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Pharika trait}

As a devotee of Pharika, you have power over affliction. You can cast {@spell ray of sickness} with this trait a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Pharika's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Pharika trait}
Pharika blesses you with Pharika's Balm, an effect that can cure or enfeeble. As an action, you can touch a creature and choose one of the following:

items: The target regains hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Wisdom modifier, and you can cure the target of one disease or neutralize one poison affecting it.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entries: You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

reward.name: Pharika's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Pharika trait}
Pharika's blessing shields you from most maladies. You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}, and you are immune to disease.

reward.name: Phenax's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Phenax trait}

As a devotee of Phenax, you have proven yourself accomplished at deception. You can call on Phenax's blessing and cast {@spell disguise self} with this trait. While the spell is active, your shadow still resembles your original form. You can cast the spell in this way a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Phenax's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Phenax trait}
When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with an attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position.

reward.name: Phenax's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Phenax trait}
Your words are inspired by Theros's greatest liar. You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks.

reward.name: Psionic Reach
entries: The psionic energy of a gem dragon empowers your mind. You gain resistance to psychic damage.

In addition, you learn the {@spell telekinesis} spell. You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast this spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma when you cast the spell with this gift (choose when you gain the gift).

reward.name: Purphoros's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Purphoros trait}

As a devotee of Purphoros, you have drawn the notice of the forge god with your skill. You can cast {@spell shield of faith} with this trait, requiring no material components, a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
In addition, you know the {@spell mending} cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

reward.name: Purphoros's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Purphoros trait}
While you are standing and an effect would push you 1 foot or more, you can use your reaction to not be pushed.

reward.name: Purphoros's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Purphoros trait}

You can cast {@spell heat metal} with this trait, requiring no material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against being knocked {@condition prone}.

reward.name: Rakdos Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell crown of madness}, {@spell hellish rebuke}, or {@spell shatter} spell. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Reliquary Charm
entries: After spending a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your {@book Bastion|XDMG|7}, you gain a magical Charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

reward.name: Sanctuary Charm
entries: After spending a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your {@book Bastion|XDMG|7}, you gain a magical Charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Healing Word|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

reward.name: Sanctum Charm
entries: After spending a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your {@book Bastion|XDMG|7}, you gain a magical Charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Heal|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

reward.name: Scaled Toughness
entries: Your skin toughens, making you resistant to certain types of physical harm. You gain resistance to piercing and slashing damage.

reward.name: Selesnya Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell aura of vitality} or {@spell conjure animals} spell. Alternatively, as an action, you can give up to three creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Female

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: NG

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Wise and virtuous

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I never show mercy to evildoers."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Nangnang

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can make one extra attack when taking the {@action Attack} action on its turn.

reward.name: Sight of the Earth-Warder
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Obsidian Warders}

You receive the Sight of the Earth-Warder. This {@book Blessing|XDMG|2|Blessings} gives you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Initiative rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Obsidian Warders falls below 10.

reward.name: Silvermoon City Charm
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with Silvermoon City}

You can request a {@book Charm|XDMG|2|Charms} from the leaders of Silvermoon City before you undertake a quest on their behalf. You receive a Charm that duplicates the effect of one of the following Wands: {@item Wand of Binding|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Enemy Detection|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Fear|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Fireballs|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Lightning Bolts|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Magic Missiles|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Paralysis|XDMG}, {@item Wand of Polymorph|XDMG}, or {@item Wand of Web|XDMG}. The Charm doesn't regain charges. It vanishes from you if you spend all its charges, if you complete or abandon the quest, or if your Renown Score with Silvermoon City falls below 25. Once you request a Charm, you can't do so again until your Renown Score with Silvermoon City increases.

reward.name: Simic Charm
entries: When you activate this charm, you can cast the {@spell enhance ability} (3rd-level version), {@spell enlarge/reduce}, or {@spell gaseous form} spell. The charm vanishes after you activate it.

reward.name: Strawbundle's Charm
entries: While you have Strawbundle in your possession, this charm allows you to cast the {@spell etherealness} spell as an action, no components required. After it is used three times, the charm vanishes.
The doll is a Tiny construct. Destroying the doll causes the child's soul within it to become trapped in {@adventure the Soulmonger|ToA|5|The Soulmonger}.

reward.name: Strength of Wrynn
entries: Whenever you roll damage, you can reroll any die that shows a 1 or 2 but must use the new roll. The Blessing lasts until Arthas is defeated.

reward.name: Strike of the Earth-Warder
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with the Dark Talons}

You receive the Strike of the Earth-Warder. This {@book Blessing|XDMG|2|Blessings} improves your Unarmed Strikes, giving you a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with them and increasing the saving throw DC of your {@variantrule Grappling|XPHB|Grapple} and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Shove} options by 1. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Dark Talons falls below 10.

reward.name: Thassa's Devotee
entries: {@i Piety 3+ Thassa trait}

As a devotee of Thassa, you have proven yourself a worthy representative of the god of the sea. You can cast {@spell fog cloud} with this trait. Fog created in this way smells strongly of the sea. You can cast the spell in this way a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: Thassa's Disciple
entries: {@i Piety 25+ Thassa trait}
You are inspired by the tempestuous, uncontrollable nature of the sea; you have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition restrained}.

reward.name: Thassa's Votary
entries: {@i Piety 10+ Thassa trait}
You can cast {@spell blink} with this trait. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

reward.name: The Blessed of Corellon
entries: Ever changing, mirthful, and beautiful, the primal elves could assume whatever sex they liked. When they bowed to Lolth's influence and chose to fix their physical forms, elves lost the ability to transform in this way. Yet occasionally elves are born who are so androgynous that they are proclaimed to be among the blessed of Corellon—living symbols of the god's love and of the primal elves' original fluid state of being. Many of Corellon's chief priests bear this blessing.

The rarest of these blessed elves can change their sex whenever they finish a long rest-a miracle celebrated by elves of all sorts except drow. (The DM decides whether an elf can manifest this miracle.) Dark elves find this ability to be terrifying and characterize it as a curse, for it could destabilize their entire society. If Corellon's blessing manifests in a drow, that elf usually flees to the surface world to seek shelter among those dedicated to Corellon.

reward.name: Time of the Dragon
entries: While holding the scale, you can use an action to summon Renesnuprah, an {@creature adult time dragon|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}). The dragon appears in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you and aids you for 10 minutes. Afterward, the time dragon vanishes, and the scale crumbles.

reward.name: Tongue of the Dragon
entries: You gain some of the majestic presence of a dragon.

entries.name: Dragon's Speech
entries: You can speak, read, and write Draconic.

entries.name: Dragon's Voice
entries: As a bonus action, you can make your voice audible up to 300 feet away for 1 minute.

entries.name: Dragon's Wiles
entries: You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks.

reward.name: Traveling Snacks
entries: After spending a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Goodberry|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Female

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: N

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Self-absorbed and indecisive

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I am incapable of making decisions."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: None

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host's Constitution score becomes 23, unless it is already higher.

reward.name: Vlagomir's Spark
entries: You gain 1 foot of height every hour and become proportionately heavier until you stand 21 feet tall and weigh 7,700 pounds. When you are 9 feet tall, your Strength becomes 19 unless it is already higher. For every 3 additional feet of height you gain, your Strength increases by 1, to a maximum of 23. Armor and clothing you are wearing and weapons you are carrying magically increase in size to match your growth. If you are the recipient of a {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic, this charm vanishes from you, and you immediately shrink back to normal size, along with any armor, clothing, and weapons in your possession.

reward.name: Wildguard Blessing
entries: {@i Prerequisite: Renown 25+ with the Cenarion Circle}

You receive the Wildguard Blessing. This {@book Blessing|XDMG|2|Blessings} gives you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells. You lose the Blessing if your Renown Score with the Cenarion Circle falls below 25.

items.name: Gender:
items.entry: Male

items.name: Alignment:
items.entry: CE

items.name: Personality:
items.entry: Violent and deranged

items.name: Inherited flaw:
items.entry: "I act without concern for the well-being of others."

items.name: Enemy:
items.entry: Moa

items.name: Power:
items.entry: The host can use an action to unleash a psionic assault on a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of the target's next turn.

reward.name: Yuan-Ti Pureblood Transformation
entries: A human can be transformed into a yuan-ti pureblood. The transformation can be undone only by a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention. A character who survives it gains a random form of {@table indefinite madness} (see "{@book Madness|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@i Dungeon Master's Guide}). A human that undergoes and survives the ritual retains its traits and gains the following yuan-ti racial traits.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: You know the {@spell poison spray} cantrip. You can cast {@spell animal friendship} an unlimited number of times with this trait, but you can target only snakes with it. Starting at 3rd level, you can also cast {@spell suggestion} with this trait. Once you cast it, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Poison Immunity
entries: You are immune to poison damage and the {@condition poisoned} condition.

facility.name: Amethyst Dragon Den
entries: This den for an amethyst dragon is an enclosed open chamber with a pool, and one of its entrances is underwater. The facility's hireling maintains the den and helps any visiting amethyst dragons feel comfortable.

entries.name: Empower: Psionic Defenses
entries: When you issue the {@book Empower|XDMG|7|Empower} order to this facility, latent draconic power fills the facility, allowing you to train in psionic combat. This training takes 8 hours per day for 7 days, after which you gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage. This benefit lasts for 7 days.

facility.name: Ancient Altar
entries: An Ancient Altar is a solemn chamber where you can make offerings to mysterious forces.

entries.name: Empower: Purge Haunted Facility
entries: You commission your hireling to lead a ritual that takes 7 days, during which time you must remain in the Bastion. At the end of the ritual, you must offer a worthy sacrifice, which can be monetary (1,000 GP) or blood (the fresh corpse of at least one Large creature or four Medium creatures that aren't Constructs or Undead). If you make a blood sacrifice, roll on the {@book Bastion Hauntings table|RHW|3|Bastion Hauntings}. Once the ritual is complete, the sacrifice is destroyed. Choose a Haunted special facility in this Bastion or in a Bastion connected to this one; that facility is no longer Haunted.

entries.name: Blasphemous Charm
entries: After spending a Long Rest in your Ancient Altar, you gain a magical {@reward Blasphemous Charm|RHW|Charm} that lasts for 7 days or until you use it.

facility.name: Arcane Study
entries: An Arcane Study is a place of quiet research that contains one or more desks and bookshelves.

entries.name: Arcane Study Charm
entries: After spending a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your Bastion, you gain a magical {@reward Arcane Study Charm|XDMG|Charm} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|XDMG|2|Supernatural Gifts}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2}) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast {@spell Identify|XPHB} without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

entries.name: Craft Options
entries: When you issue the {@book Craft|XDMG|7|Craft} order to this facility, choose one of the following options:

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Arcane Focus. You commission the facility's hireling to craft an {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB}. The work takes 7 days and costs no money. The Arcane Focus remains in your Bastion until you claim it.

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Book. You commission the facility's hireling to craft a blank book. The work takes 7 days and costs you 10 GP. The book remains in your Bastion until you claim it.

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Magic Item (Arcana). If you are level 9+, you can commission the facility's hireling to craft a Common or an Uncommon magic item chosen by you from the {@book Arcana tables|XDMG|6|Arcana Tables} in {@book chapter 7|XDMG|6}. The facility has the tool required to craft the item, and the hireling has proficiency with that tool as well as proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill. See the "{@book Crafting Magic Items|XDMG|6|Crafting Magic Items}" section in {@book chapter 7|XDMG|6} for the time and money that must be spent to craft the item. If the item allows its user to cast any spells from it, you must craft the item yourself (the facility's hireling can assist), and you must have all those spells prepared every day you spend crafting the item.

facility.name: Archive
entries: An Archive is a repository of valuable books, maps, and scrolls. It is usually attached to a Library behind a locked or secret door.

entries.name: Research: Helpful Lore
entries: When you issue the {@book Research|XDMG|7|Research} order to this facility, you commission the facility's hireling to search the Archive for helpful lore. The work takes 7 days. The hireling gains knowledge as if they had cast the {@spell Legend Lore|XPHB} spell, then shares this knowledge with you the next time you speak with them.

entries.name: Reference Book
entries: Your Archive contains one copy of a rare and valuable reference book, which gives you a benefit while you and the book are in your Bastion. You can choose one of the following options (your DM might make more options available):

items.name: Bigby's Handy Arcana Codex
items.entry: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check you make when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to recall lore about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, and planes of existence.

items.name: The Chronepsis Chronicles
items.entry: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Intelligence ({@skill History|XPHB}) check you make when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to recall lore about historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, past disputes, wars, and lost civilizations.

items.name: Investigations of the Inquisitive
items.entry: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check you make when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to make deductions based on clues or evidence or to recall lore about traps, ciphers, riddles, and gadgetry.

items.name: Material Musings on the Nature of the World
items.entry: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) check you make when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and the weather.

items.name: The Old Faith and Other Religions
items.entry: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Intelligence ({@skill Religion|XPHB}) check you make when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, hierarchies, holy symbols, and the practices of secret cults.

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Archive to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, you gain two additional reference books chosen from the list above.

facility.name: Armory
entries: An Armory contains mannequins for displaying armor, hooks for holding Shields, racks for storing weapons, and chests for holding ammunition.

entries.name: Trade: Stock Armory
entries: When you issue the {@book Trade|XDMG|7|Trade} order to this facility, you commission the facility's hireling to stock the Armory with armor, {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}, weapons, and ammunition. This equipment costs you 100 GP plus an extra 100 GP for each Bastion Defender in your Bastion. If your Bastion has a {@facility Smithy|XDMG}, the total cost is halved.

While your Armory is stocked, your Bastion Defenders are harder to kill. When any event causes you to roll dice to determine if your Bastion loses one or more of its defenders (see "{@book Bastion Events|XDMG|7|Bastion Events}" at the end of this chapter), roll {@dice 1d8} in place of each {@dice d6} you would normally roll. When the event is over, the equipment in your Armory is expended regardless of how many Bastion Defenders you have or how many you lost, leaving your Armory depleted until you issue another Trade order to the facility and pay the cost to restock it.

facility.name: Artificer's Forge
entries: An Artificer's Forge includes two magewright hirelings who are skilled in creating magic items.

entries.name: Crafting Assistants
entries: If you {@book create a magic item|XDMG|2|Creating a Magic Item} in your Bastion using the rules in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}, one or both of this facility's hirelings can assist you, reducing the time required for the crafting.

entries.name: Craft: Magic Item
entries: When you issue the Craft order to this facility, you commission the facility's hirelings to craft a {@book Common or an Uncommon magic item|XDMG|6|Magic Items} chosen by you from the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}. The facility has the tool required to craft the item, and the hirelings have proficiency with that tool as well as proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill. The two hirelings assist each other, reducing the time required to craft the item. If the item allows its user to cast any spells from it, the hirelings have those spells prepared.

entries.name: Charge Refreshment
entries: Whenever a magic item in your Bastion regains charges, it regains 1 extra expended charge.

facility.name: Barrack
entries: A Bastion can have more than one Barrack, each of which is furnished to serve as sleeping quarters for up to twelve Bastion Defenders.

entries.name: Recruit: Bastion Defenders
entries: Each time you issue the {@book Recruit|XDMG|7|Recruit} order to this facility, up to four Bastion Defenders are recruited to your Bastion and assigned quarters in this Barrack. The recruitment costs no money. You can't issue the Recruit order to this facility if it's fully occupied.

Keep track of the Bastion Defenders housed in each of your Barracks. If you lose Bastion Defenders, deduct them from your roster. Assign names and personalities to your Bastion Defenders as you see fit.

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Barrack to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. A Vast Barrack can accommodate up to twenty-five Bastion Defenders.

facility.name: Bedroom
entries: A basic facility comes with nonmagical furnishings and decor appropriate for that facility.

facility.name: Cabinet of Curiosities
entries: A Cabinet of Curiosities is a small salon, closet space, or antechamber where you can keep and catalog peculiar objects and fascinating oddities.

entries.name: Trade: Acquire Curios
entries: When you issue the Trade order to this facility, you supply this facility's hireling with a certain amount of gold and commission them to purchase strange items from unusual sources. It takes 28 days for the hireling to return to the Bastion with one or more magic items for you. Your investment determines the rarity of these items, and the quantity of magic items depends on the number of Haunted special facilities in your Bastion at the time of the hireling's return, as shown on the Curio Investment and Curios Collected tables.

To determine how many magic items your hireling brings back, count the Haunted special facilities in your Bastion, then roll the die indicated in the Magic Items Acquired column on the Curios Collected table. The DM rolls on the Cursed Item Chance ({@dice 1d100}) column to determine whether one of the magic items carries a curse. The DM chooses which item is cursed and establishes the nature of the curse.

For each magic item acquired, roll on a table in the "{@book Random Magic Items|XDMG|9}" section in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG} of the corresponding rarity to determine what the item is. (Select the treasure theme randomly.)

facility.name: Circus Tent
entries: The Circus Tent is a space for musical, acrobatic, comedic, or other performances intended to delight a crowd. The tent includes seating for audience members. Your hirelings are {@creature Performer|XMM|Performers} whose alignment matches your own. Assign names, personalities, and circus acts to them as you see fit.

entries.name: Trade: Circus Performance
entries: When you issue the {@book Trade|XDMG|7|Trade} order to this facility, the facility's hirelings turn the Circus Tent into a performance venue for 7 days. At the end of the seventh day, your portion of the proceeds is equal to {@dice 2d6 × 10} GP.

facility.name: Construct Forge
entries: A Construct Forge is used to create Constructs.

entries.name: Recruit: Construct
entries: When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, you commission the facility's hirelings to craft a Construct from the Forge Constructs table. The construction takes the time and costs you the amount listed in the table.

Constructs made in this facility count as Bastion Defenders. Deduct any you lose from your Bastion Defenders roster. You can choose not to count one or more of these creatures as Bastion Defenders, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion. Instead, they act in accordance with their nature and use their stat blocks in the {@book Monster Manual|XMM}.

entries.caption: Forge Constructs
footnotes: *{@creature Warforged Titan|ERLW|The Warforged Titan stat block} appears in {@book Eberron: Rising from the Last War|ERLW}. Creating new Warforged Titans is illegal under the terms of the Treaty of Korth, which ended the Last War. Violating that treaty risks reigniting open war across Khorvaire.

facility.name: Courtyard
entries: A basic facility comes with nonmagical furnishings and decor appropriate for that facility.

facility.name: Cult of the Dragon Archive
entries: A Cult of the Dragon Archive contains extensive records on specific topics, including dragons.

entries.name: Research: Helpful Lore
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you commission the facility's hireling to search the archive for lore. The work takes 7 days. The hireling gains knowledge as if they had cast the {@spell Legend Lore|XPHB} spell, then shares this knowledge with you the next time you speak with them.

entries.name: Reference Books
entries: Your Cult of the Dragon Archive contains a collection of draconic lore. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB} or {@skill Religion|XPHB}) checks you make in your Bastion when you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to recall lore about Dragons, Tiamat, or the Cult of the Dragon.

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Cult of the Dragon Archive to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, you gain two reference books chosen from those listed in the Archive entry in {@book chapter 8|XDMG|7} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}.

facility.name: Demiplane
entries: A door up to 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall appears on a flat, solid surface in one of the other facilities in your Bastion. You choose the location. If you are in your Bastion during a Bastion turn, you can relocate this door to another facility in your Bastion.

Only you and your Bastion's hirelings can open the door, which leads to a Demiplane that takes the form of a stone room. The Demiplane exists in an extradimensional space and therefore isn't attached physically to other locations in your Bastion. Neither the Demiplane nor its door can be dispelled.

entries.name: Empower: Arcane Resilience
entries: When you issue the {@book Empower|XDMG|7|Empower} order to this facility, magical runes appear on the Demiplane's walls and last for 7 days. Until the runes disappear, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to five times your level after spending an entire {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in the Demiplane.

entries.name: Fabrication
entries: While in the Demiplane, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a nonmagical object of your choice from nothing, causing it to appear in an unoccupied space in the Demiplane. The object can be no bigger than 5 feet in any dimension; can't have a value over 5 GP; and must be made of wood, stone, clay, porcelain, glass, paper, nonprecious crystal, or nonprecious metal. You must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can take this action again.

facility.name: Dining Room
entries: A basic facility comes with nonmagical furnishings and decor appropriate for that facility.

facility.name: Dragonmark Outpost

otherSummary.entry: Renown 10+ with any {@book dragonmarked house|EFA|5|Dragonmarked House Renown}

entries: A Dragonmark Outpost is an area set aside for the use of your dragonmarked house. The hireling is a house agent and serves as a liaison between you and your superiors in the house.
When you add this facility to your Bastion, your Renown Score with your house increases by 1.

entries.name: Dragonmark Empowerment (Requires Any Dragonmark Feat)
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in your Bastion, you gain one extra spell slot of level 2. You can use this spell slot to cast only a spell you have prepared because of a {@book Dragonmark feat|EFA|2|Dragonmark Feats}.

entries.name: Empower: House Favor
entries: When you issue the Empower order to this facility, you instruct your hireling to call in a favor from your dragonmarked house. You can use any benefit of your house that your Renown Score affords you (as described in {@book chapter 5|EFA|5|Dragonmarked House Renown}), and this favor doesn't count against the total number of favors available to you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until your Renown Score with your house increases.

facility.name: Emerald Enclave Grove
entries: Veteran agents of the Emerald Enclave create safe havens with trees, grass, and flowing water, where magical creatures that embody the power of nature live in peace and safety. The Emerald Enclave Grove can house one Huge creature or two Large creatures; four Small or Medium creatures or eight Tiny creatures can occupy the same space as one Large creature there.

entries.name: Recruit: Creature of Nature
entries: When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, you invite a creature from the Emerald Enclave Grove Creatures table to your Emerald Enclave Grove. Roll any die. If the number rolled is odd, the creature doesn't accept your invitation and you gain no benefit from having issued the order. If the number rolled is even, a creature accepts your invitation and moves into your Emerald Enclave Grove after 7 days. Your hirelings care for the creature and perform upkeep in the facility.

Creatures in your Emerald Enclave Grove count as Bastion Defenders. Deduct any you lose from your Bastion Defenders roster. You can choose not to count one or more of these creatures as Bastion Defenders, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion. Instead, they act in accordance with their nature and use their stat blocks in the {@book Monster Manual|XMM}.

facility.name: Entertainment Salon
entries: This fancy salon boasts elegant wall hangings, comfortable reclining couches, and a well-stocked bar.

entries.name: Open Pockets
entries: Your eloquent hirelings convince others to pay a little more or to accept a little less. When you roll a die to determine how many Gold Pieces you pay or gain for a {@book Bastion|XDMG|7|Gaining a Bastion} order or event, you can roll twice and take either result.

entries.name: Research: Learn Secrets
entries: When you issue the {@book Research|XDMG|7|Research} order to this facility, you direct the facility's hirelings to entertain well-informed contacts and learn about a specific creature you name within 50 miles of your Bastion. After 7 days of work, the hirelings gain {@dice 1d4} facts about the named creature that aren't widely known and might be amusing, embarrassing, or useful. The hirelings also discover the creature's power relative to yours (such as whether the creature's CR is higher than, lower than, or the same as your level). At the DM's discretion, you might receive limited or incorrect information about an exceptionally private or supernaturally disguised creature.

facility.name: Gaming Hall
entries: A Gaming Hall offers recreational activities like chess and games of darts, cards, or dice.

entries.name: Trade: Gambling Hall
entries: When you issue the {@book Trade|XDMG|7|Trade} order to this facility, the facility's hirelings turn the Gaming Hall into a gambling den for 7 days. At the end of the seventh day, roll {@dice 1d100} and consult the following table to determine your portion of the house's winnings.

facility.name: Garden
entries: A Bastion can have more than one Garden. Each time you add a Garden to your Bastion, choose its type from the options in the Garden Types table.
While in your Bastion, you can instruct the facility's hireling to change the Garden from one type to another. This work takes 21 days, during which time no other activity can occur in this facility.

entries.name: Harvest: Garden Growth
entries: When you issue the {@book Harvest|XDMG|7|Harvest} order to this facility, you commission the facility's hireling to collect items from the Garden as noted in the Garden Types table. The work takes 7 days and costs no money.

entries.caption: Garden Types
rows: Aesthetically pleasing garden full of flowers and topiaries.
Ten exquisite floral bouquets (worth 5 GP each), ten vials of {@item Perfume|XPHB}, or ten {@item Candle|XPHB|Candles}
Garden of delicious mushrooms or vegetables
Garden of rare herbs, some of which have medicinal uses
Herbs that are used to create either ten {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB|Healer's Kits} or one {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG}
Garden stocked with plants and fungi from which poisons and antitoxin can be extracted
Plants that are used to create either two vials of {@item Antitoxin|XPHB} or one vial of {@item Basic Poison|XPHB}

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Garden to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. A Vast Garden is equivalent to two Roomy Gardens and can include two of the same type of Garden or two different types. When you issue the Harvest order to a Vast Garden, each component garden produces its own harvest. A Vast Garden gains one additional hireling.

facility.name: Geothermal Vent
entries: A geothermal vent draws heat from deep below the surface to provide energy and power simple machines.

entries.name: Empower: Withstand Heat
entries: When you issue the {@book Empower|XDMG|7|Empower} order to this facility, for the next 7 days, the facility's hireling teaches a series of meditative techniques that allow a character to mitigate the injuries they suffer from flames. Any character who trains here for at least 8 hours on each of those days gains the following benefit at the end of the training period:

items.name: Heat Tolerant
items.entry: When you take Fire damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce this damage by {@dice 1d4} plus your level. This benefit lasts for 7 days.

entries.name: Hot Water
entries: Your basic facilities benefit from a constant source of adjustable heat. For example, a dining room has a warming table to keep food hot, a kitchen has multiple ovens with varying heat, and a bedroom has a basin that warms water for washing.

facility.name: Greenhouse
entries: A Greenhouse is an enclosure where rare plants and fungi are nurtured in a controlled climate.

entries.name: Fruit of Restoration
entries: One plant in your Greenhouse has three magical fruits growing on it. Any creature that eats one of these fruits gains the benefit of a {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell. Fruits that aren't eaten within 24 hours of being picked lose their magic. The plant replaces all picked fruits daily at dawn, and it can't be transplanted without killing it.

entries.name: Harvest Options
entries: When you issue the {@book Harvest|XDMG|7|Harvest} order to this facility, choose one of the following options:

items.name: Harvest:
items.entry: Healing Herbs. You commission the facility's hireling to create a {@item Potion of Greater Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing (greater)} made from healing herbs. The work takes 7 days and costs no money.

items.name: Harvest:
items.entry: Poison. You commission the facility's hireling to extract one application of a poison from rare plants or fungi. Choose the type of poison from the following options: {@item Assassin's Blood|XDMG}, {@item Malice|XDMG}, {@item Pale Tincture|XDMG}, or {@item Truth Serum|XDMG}. See "{@book Poison|XDMG|2|Poison}" in {@book chapter 3|XDMG|2} for each poison's effect. Once harvested, the poison can be contained in a vial. The work takes 7 days and costs no money.

facility.name: Guildhall
entries: A Guildhall comes with a guild, for which you are the guild master. Choose the type of guild from the options in the Sample Guilds table, or work with your DM to create a new guild. The facility is a meeting room where members of your guild can discuss important matters in your presence.
Your guild has roughly fifty members made up of skilled folk who live and work outside your Bastion, usually in nearby settlements.

entries.name: Recruit: Guild Assignment
entries: Each time you issue the {@book Recruit|XDMG|7|Recruit} order to this facility, you commission the facility's hireling to recruit guild members to perform a special assignment. Each guild in the Sample Guilds table specifies the nature of that assignment. With your DM's permission and help, you can create new assignments for guild members to complete.

entries.caption: Sample Guilds
rows: You send adventurers to track down a Beast that has a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of 2 or lower and is known to lair within 50 miles of your Bastion. The adventurers slay or capture the creature (your choice) in {@dice 1d6 + 1} days. If the creature is slain and your Bastion has a Trophy Room, you can add a trophy taken from the creature to that facility. If the creature is captured and your Bastion has a Menagerie, you can add the creature to that facility, provided the facility has space to house it.

You assign bakers to create baked goods for a prestigious event that occurs within the next 7 days. You can receive payment in coin (500 GP) or in the form of a favor owed to you by the event's host, the details of which are left to you and the DM.
You assign brewers to deliver fifty 40-gallon barrels of ale (worth 10 GP each) to your Bastion in 7 days.

You assign masons to add a defensive wall to your Bastion at no cost. Alternatively, you can have the masons perform this work for another character's Bastion, provided their Bastion is within 1 mile of yours. Each 5-foot square of defensive wall takes 1 day to build instead of 10 (see "{@book Bastion Map|XDMG|7|Bastion Map}").

You assign shipbuilders to build one of the vehicles in the {@table Large Vehicles; Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles|XPHB|Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles} table of the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You pay the full cost of the vehicle, and the work takes 1 day per 1,000 GP of the vehicle's cost (a {@item Rowboat|XPHB} can be made in 1 day).

You assign thieves to infiltrate a location within 50 miles of your Bastion and steal a nonmagical object from it. The object can be no bigger than 5 feet in any dimension and is delivered to your Bastion in {@dice 1d6 + 1} days. The DM may decide this activity leaves you at risk of retaliation from law enforcement or the victim.

facility.name: Harper Hideout
entries: You have a safe house hidden near your Bastion and connected to it by a tunnel no more than a quarter mile in length. Your hireling maintains the hideout, using a cover identity that doesn't link them to your Bastion. You can change the location of your Harper Hideout each time you gain a level.

entries.name: Hideout Defenses
entries: Your Harper Hideout is constantly protected by the {@spell Alarm|XPHB} spell. At level 9, your Harper Hideout can be connected to your Bastion by a magic doorway instead of a tunnel; anyone passing through the door from the Harper Hideout emerges from a specific door in your Bastion or vice versa, and your Harper Hideout can be located anywhere within 100 miles of your Bastion. At level 13, the facility can be located anywhere in Faerûn. At level 17, the magic doorway works across planes, and the facility can be anywhere in the multiverse.

entries.name: Empower: Harper Training
entries: When you issue the {@book Empower|XDMG|7|Empower} order to this facility, the facility's hireling extends an invitation to another Harper agent nearby. Roll any die. If the number is odd, no Harper needs your facility and you gain no benefit from having issued the order. If the number rolled is even, a {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} Harper takes up temporary residence in your hideout.

The Harper stays for 7 days. While at your Bastion, the Harper can share their knowledge. Any character who trains with the Harper here for at least 8 hours on each of those days gains proficiency in one of the following skills of their choice: {@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Investigation|XPHB}, or {@skill Performance|XPHB}. This benefit lasts for 7 days.
The Harper won't defend your Bastion and departs immediately if the Bastion is attacked.

facility.name: Heist Planning Chamber
entries: This room has a planning table, pieces of miniature terrain to represent walls or furniture, and tomes on magical security, architecture, and spy craft useful when planning a heist.

entries.name: Research: Reconnaissance
entries: When you issue the {@book Research|XDMG|7|Research} order to this facility, your hireling sends spies to evaluate a building within 50 miles of your Bastion. This work takes 7 days. At the end of the seventh day, the hireling provides a model of the building on the planning table. Public areas of the building are depicted accurately, and private areas are depicted only generally. Any area concealed by magic or protected by powerful guardians, at the DM's discretion, might not be depicted accurately or at all. The spies avoid all creatures, so information about the building's inhabitants is sparse.
The model remains until you use the {@book Research|XDMG|7|Research} order on this facility again, but it might become inaccurate over time if the building changes.

entries.name: Heist Preparations
entries: A character who prepares for a theft or infiltration using the model for at least 8 hours chooses one of the following roles. The role's benefit applies while the character is within 1 mile of the building depicted by the model and lasts for 7 days or until you prepare again:

items.name: Enforcer:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks

items.name: Face:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks

items.name: Lookout:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks

items.name: Medic:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) checks

items.name: Sneak:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks

items.name: Thief:
items.entry: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) checks

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Heist Planning Chamber to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the range of Reconnaissance increases to 500 miles, and a character preparing for a heist can choose two roles, gaining the benefits of both.

facility.name: Infirmary
entries: An Infirmary provides emergency healing and continual care to injured or sick Bastion occupants.

entries.name: Craft Options
entries: When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following options:

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Antitoxin. You commission the facility's hirelings to craft two vials of {@item Antitoxin|XPHB}. The work takes 7 days and costs no money. You can spend 50 GP during the creation process to enhance one of the vials of Antitoxin, or 100 GP to enhance both. An enhanced Antitoxin ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on the creature that drinks it. An enhanced Antitoxin loses this enhancement after 28 days.

items.name: Craft:
items.entry: Enhanced Potion of Healing. You commission this facility's hirelings to increase the potency of up to two {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG|Potions of Healing}. You must provide the potions to be enhanced, and the process takes 14 days to complete. A Potion of Healing becomes a {@item Potion of Greater Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing (greater)}. When you reach level 13 you can provide up to two Potions of Healing (greater), each of which becomes a {@item Potion of Superior Healing|XDMG|Potion of Healing (superior)}.

entries.name: Triage
entries: When your Bastion is attacked and you roll a number of dice to determine how many Bastion Defenders are lost, you can reroll a number of those dice equal to the number of hirelings this facility has. You must use the new roll.

entries.name: Enlarging the Facility
entries: You can enlarge your Infirmary to a Vast facility by spending 2,000 GP. If you do so, the Infirmary gains two hirelings, and the number of Antitoxins or Potions of Healing you can enhance at a time increases to four.

facility.name: Inquisitive Agency
entries: This facility is an office for an inquisitive agency—either the headquarters of an agency you control or a branch office for a larger agency (such as {@book Middle Dura|EFA|4|Middle Dura} or {@book Karr'Aashta's Investigations|EFA|4|Karr'Aashta's Investigations}, both of which are discussed in chapter 4). Its one hireling is a secretary who maintains an extensive directory of useful contacts and helpful agents.

entries.name: Research: Information Gathering
entries: When you issue the Research order to this facility, you commission the agency's secretary to gather information from contacts and agents regarding a specific individual you designate, assembling a comprehensive picture of that person's activities during the previous 7 days and over the course of the next 7 days, within 10 miles of your Bastion. Unless the DM deems that certain information is beyond these agents' ability to uncover, you learn the following information:

items: Where the person is and has been staying
What they've spent money on
Whom they've met with
Where they've shown identification papers to the authorities

entries: If your Bastion is mobile, it takes time to establish this network of agents in a new place. When your Bastion is traveling, you can't issue the Research order to this facility. After it arrives at its destination, the first time you issue the Research order, this facility's hireling spends 7 days establishing a new network, after which you can use the Research order normally.

facility.name: Kitchen
entries: A basic facility comes with nonmagical furnishings and decor appropriate for that facility.

facility.name: Kundarak Vault
entries: A Kundarak Vault occupies space in your Bastion like any other special facility, but it is an extradimensional space that can be accessed from other places. As a Kundarak facility, it provides exceptionally secure storage for your trade goods and other treasures. Only you and your Bastion's hirelings can open the vault door.

entries.name: Kundarak Access
entries: Because the vault is an extradimensional space, you (and only you) can access its contents from any Kundarak bank facility in the world. These banks are found in cities across {@book Khorvaire|ERLW|5|Nations of Khorvaire} (and also in {@book Stormreach, in Xen'drik|ERLW|6|Notable Locations|2}).

entries.name: Trade: Goods
entries: When you issue the Trade order to this facility, its hireling spends the next 7 days procuring nonmagical items that have a total value of 2,000 GP or less and stores them in the Kundarak Vault, or the hireling uses those 7 days to sell goods in the Kundarak Vault. You bear the total cost of any purchases, and the maximum value of the items purchased increases to 5,000 GP when you reach level 13.
